# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives

## Overview

Build a bold, modern landing page for **CreativeHub**, an online learning platform for creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists. The page should feel energetic and inspiring — like stepping into a vibrant creative studio. The goal is simple: get visitors excited about the platform and drive them to start a free trial.

## Vibe & Visual Direction

Think **Skillshare meets Dribbble** — playful yet polished. Use a vibrant color palette anchored by a deep navy or charcoal background in the hero with pops of coral/orange, electric green, or warm yellow as accent colors. Typography should be bold and contemporary — a chunky geometric sans-serif for headlines (like Plus Jakarta Sans or similar) paired with a clean body font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, and subtle hover animations will reinforce the modern, approachable feel.

## Key Priorities

- **Hero conversion flow**: The hero is the most critical section. It needs to immediately communicate the value prop and present two clear sign-up paths (Google and email). Make these CTAs impossible to miss. The category pills beneath should feel browsable and inviting.

- **Course category tabs**: The tabbed course grid is the core interactive experience. Switching between categories (Featured, Music, Drawing & Painting, etc.) should feel instant and smooth. Each course card needs a thumbnail, title, instructor name, student count, and duration — make them visually rich.

- **Teacher carousel**: The horizontal scrolling teacher section should feel tactile and explorable, with clear navigation affordances (arrows or scroll indicators).

- **FAQ accordion**: Clean expand/collapse behavior — only one item open at a time feels best here.

- **Stats section**: The platform numbers (425k+ members, 30k+ classes, etc.) should land with visual impact — large type, maybe a contrasting background band.

## Note

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full section list, data content, and interaction specs. The page is responsive, light mode only.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

The platform empowers creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists with hands-on video lessons, structured learning paths, and a vibrant peer community. The tone is modern, playful, and bold.

# CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives

## Brand
CreativeHub is an online learning community offering thousands of creative classes taught by industry professionals, from illustration and design to photography and filmmaking. The platform empowers creative professionals, hobbyists, and aspiring artists with hands-on video lessons, structured learning paths, and a vibrant peer community. The tone is modern, playful, and bold.

Brand colors: #000000 (primary black), #55DA9B (accent green), #5620C1 (accent purple)

## Hero Content
Title: Creative Classes Taught by the Best Creative Pros
Subtitle: Get 7 free days of CreativeHub
CTA: "Continue with Google" | "Continue with email"
Legal note: By signing up you agree to CreativeHub's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, and agree to receive marketing communications from CreativeHub at the email address provided.

## Course Categories
Horizontal scrolling category pills displayed in the hero area:
- Graphic Design
- Illustration
- Animation
- Film & Video
- Freelance
- UI/UX Design
- Productivity
- Photography
- Fine Art
- Marketing

## Value Propositions
**Creative Learning Made Easy**
- **Thousands of creative classes.** Beginner to pro.
- **Taught by creative pros and industry icons.**
- **Learning Paths** to help you achieve your goals.
- **Certificates** to celebrate your accomplishments.

## Platform Statistics
| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Members | 425k+ |
| Classes | 30k+ |
| Teachers | 9k+ |
| App Store Rating | 4.8 ★ |

## Featured Courses
Section title: Explore Inspiring Online Courses

Category tabs: Featured · Music · Drawing & Painting · Marketing · Animation · Social Media · UI/UX Design · Creative Writing · Digital Illustration · Film & Video · Crafts · Freelance & Entrepreneurship · Graphic Design · Photography · Productivity

| Course Title | Instructor | Students | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kickstart your Creativity with Procreate: 20 Fun Drawings for Beginners and Beyond | Lisa Bardot | 24,872 | 6h 24m |
| Social Media Content Creation in Canva: From Beginner to Advanced | Maggie Stara | 44,495 | 13h 19m |
| Landscapes: A Free-Flow Watercolour Masterclass | Jane Davies | 2,579 | 1h 42m |
| Figma UI UX Design Advanced: Become a Pro | Daniel Scott | 6,692 | 8h 48m |
| ChatGPT for Creatives: AI-Powered SEO, Marketing, & Productivity | Peggy Dean | 18,842 | 1h 18m |
| How to Draw: A Beginner's Guide | Brent Eviston | 26,243 | 5h 57m |
| Learn Video Editing With Premiere Pro For Beginners | Jordy Vandeput | 17,887 | 3h 44m |
| iPhone Photography Essentials: Take Pro Photos With Your iPhone | Sean Dalton | 13,423 | 1h 34m |

## Creative Feed
Section title: Explore Your Creative Feed

- **Stay Inspired** — Discover trending topics, get quick answers, and find your people.
- **Stay Connected** — Follow your peers and teachers, exchange perspectives, and share some love.
- **Keep Creating** — Explore new ideas for your next project, post your work, and get feedback.

## Expert Teachers
Section title: Learn from Creative Experts
Subtitle: CreativeHub teachers are industry leaders excited to share their tools, techniques, and professional journeys with you.

| Name | Specialty |
|---|---|
| Lisa Bardot | Illustrator |
| Daniel Scott | Digital Designer |
| Derek Elliot | Animator, Product Designer |
| Aaron Draplin | Graphic Designer |
| Zaneena Nabeel | Watercolor Artist |
| Emonee LaRussa | Motion Graphics Artist |
| Brent Eviston | Master Artist |
| Jordy Vandeput | Filmmaker and Youtuber |

## Student Testimonials
Section title: Why Students Love CreativeHub

- **Rachel R** — "CreativeHub was the best learning decision I've ever made… Real-world skills without the financial burden of traditional school."
- **Elli V** — "I love that CreativeHub is a platform where I can find other creatives and we can support each other on our learning journey."
- **Katrina** — "It's rare that I subscribe for anything, but this is one subscription I can't imagine not having."
- **Savonne M** — "CreativeHub helps me level up my skills, while also letting me explore… teachers bring vibrant personalities and valuable insights."

## Teams
Section title: CreativeHub for Teams
Body: Set your team up for success with reimagined learning to empower their personal and professional growth. With inspiring classes on soft skills, business essentials, well-being and more, your whole team will have deep knowledge and expertise at their fingertips.
CTA: "Learn More"

## FAQ
Section title: Frequently Asked Questions

- **What is CreativeHub?** — CreativeHub is an online learning community with thousands of classes for creative and curious people, on topics including illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. On CreativeHub, you'll find inspiration from hands-on classes and teachers at the top of their creative fields, so you can take the next step in your creative journey.
- **What is included in my membership?** — As a CreativeHub member, you'll have unlimited access to all classes to watch when and where you want, plus additional features such as offline viewing, access to a vibrant community of lifelong learners, and so much more.
- **What can I learn?** — CreativeHub has thousands of classes in everything from graphic design to cooking, productivity, filmmaking, content creation, UI/UX design, marketing, crafts, music, social media, and entrepreneurship. If it's something creative, you can learn it on CreativeHub.
- **What happens after my trial is over?** — After your trial ends, your annual CreativeHub membership begins. You'll be billed for the year in full, so you can enjoy continuous access to creative classes year-round.
- **Can I teach on the platform?** — Yes! CreativeHub teachers are everyday creatives and professionals who want to share their passion and the skills they've gained with a community of eager learners. Visit our Help Center to learn more.

## Footer Navigation
**Art & Illustration:** Illustration · Digital Art · Drawing · Painting · Watercolor
**Graphic Design:** Graphic Design · UI/UX Design · Type Design · Surface Pattern Design · Motion Design
**Creative Career:** Marketing · Freelance · AI · Productivity · Social Media

**Software:** Procreate · Adobe Illustrator · ChatGPT · Blender · Canva

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --black: #000000;
      --green: #55DA9B;
      --purple: #5620C1;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --gray-50: #f9fafb;
      --gray-100: #f3f4f6;
      --gray-200: #e5e7eb;
      --gray-300: #d1d5db;
      --gray-400: #9ca3af;
      --gray-500: #6b7280;
      --gray-600: #4b5563;
      --gray-700: #374151;
      --gray-800: #1f2937;
      --gray-900: #111827;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-900);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* ── NAV ── */
    nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 0 2rem;
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--black);
      text-decoration: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }
    .logo-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-left: auto;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--black); }
    .btn-nav-signup {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .btn-nav-signup:hover { background: var(--purple); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 5rem 2rem 4rem;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(86,32,193,0.35) 0%, transparent 70%),
                  radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 80% 80%, rgba(85,218,155,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 760px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      background: rgba(85,218,155,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(85,218,155,0.3);
      color: var(--green);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.75rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .hero h1 span { color: var(--green); }
    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .btn-google {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-800);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      width: 340px;
      max-width: 100%;
      transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }
    .btn-google:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
    .btn-email {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      width: 340px;
      max-width: 100%;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }
    .btn-email:hover { border-color: var(--green); background: rgba(85,218,155,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .hero-legal {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      max-width: 500px;
      margin: 0 auto 2.5rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .hero-legal a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); text-decoration: underline; }

    /* Category pills */
    .hero-categories {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .hero-categories::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .pill {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .pill:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); color: var(--black); }

    /* Hero illustration grid */
    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .hero-card {
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-card-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-card-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.75));
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1.5rem 0.6rem 0.6rem;
      text-align: left;
    }

    /* ── SECTION COMMON ── */
    section { padding: 5rem 2rem; }
    .section-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.85rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.75rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    /* ── FEATURES ── */
    .features { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 2rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .feature-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .feature-card h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .feature-card p { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--gray-500); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── STATS ── */
    .stats { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); padding: 4.5rem 2rem; }
    .stats-grid {
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    /* ── COURSES ── */
    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .tab-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--black); }

    .courses-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .course-card {
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: var(--white);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .course-thumb {

  let activeCategory = 'featured';

  function renderCourses(category) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('coursesGrid');
    const filtered = allCourses.filter(c => c.categories.includes(category));
    const courses = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : allCourses.slice(0, 8);

    grid.style.opacity = '0';
    grid.style.transform = 'translateY(8px)';
    grid.style.transition = 'opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s';

    setTimeout(() => {
      grid.innerHTML = courses.map(course => `
        <div class="course-card" onclick="alert('Opening: ${course.title.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
          <div class="course-thumb" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, ${course.color}22, ${course.color}44);">
            <span style="font-size: 3rem;">${course.emoji}</span>
            <span class="course-thumb-label">⏱ ${course.duration}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="course-body">
            <p class="course-instructor">${course.instructor}</p>
            <h3>${course.title}</h3>
            <div class="course-meta">
              <span>👤 ${course.students} students</span>
              <span style="color: var(--gray-300);">·</span>
              <span>🕐 ${course.duration}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      grid.style.opacity = '1';
      grid.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    }, 150);
  }

  function switchTab(btn, category) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    activeCategory = category;
    renderCourses(category);
  }

  /* ── TEACHERS ── */
  function scrollTeachers(dir) {
    const scroll = document.getElementById('teacherScroll');
    scroll.scrollBy({ left: dir * 260, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  /* ── FAQ ACCORDION ── */
  function toggleFaq(btn) {
    const item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
    const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
    if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
  }

  /* ── EMAIL MODAL ── */
  function openEmailModal() {
    document.getElementById('emailModal').classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeEmailModal() {
    document.getElementById('emailModal').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function closeModalOnOverlay(e) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeEmailModal();
  }

  /* Escape key closes modal */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeEmailModal();
  });

  /* ── INIT ── */
  renderCourses('featured');

  /* Escape key closes modal */

    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeEmailModal();

  /* ── INIT ── */
  renderCourses('featured');

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>CreativeHub — Online Classes for Creatives</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --black: #000000;
      --green: #55DA9B;
      --purple: #5620C1;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --gray-50: #f9fafb;
      --gray-100: #f3f4f6;
      --gray-200: #e5e7eb;
      --gray-300: #d1d5db;
      --gray-400: #9ca3af;
      --gray-500: #6b7280;
      --gray-600: #4b5563;
      --gray-700: #374151;
      --gray-800: #1f2937;
      --gray-900: #111827;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--gray-900);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* ── NAV ── */
    nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;

      padding: 0 2rem;

      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      height: 64px;
    }
    .logo {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--black);
      text-decoration: none;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }
    .logo-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
    }
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-left: auto;
    }

      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;

      text-decoration: none;

      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

      content: '';

      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;

    .btn-email {

    .pill {

      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .pill:hover { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); color: var(--black); }

    /* Hero illustration grid */
    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 3.5rem;
      max-width: 900px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }
    .hero-card {
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-card-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    .hero-card-label {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.75));
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1.5rem 0.6rem 0.6rem;
      text-align: left;
    }

    /* ── SECTION COMMON ── */
    section { padding: 5rem 2rem; }
    .section-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.25rem 0.85rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.75rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    /* ── FEATURES ── */
    .features { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 2rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .feature-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
    .feature-icon {
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }
    .feature-card h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .feature-card p { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--gray-500); line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── STATS ── */
    .stats { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); padding: 4.5rem 2rem; }
    .stats-grid {
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 2rem;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .stat-number {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--green);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    /* ── COURSES ── */
    .course-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding-bottom: 0.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .course-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .tab-btn {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--purple); color: var(--purple); }
    .tab-btn.active { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--black); }

    .courses-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .course-card {
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: var(--white);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .course-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .course-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .course-thumb-label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0.75rem;
      right: 0.75rem;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      color: white;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }
    .course-body { padding: 1.25rem; }
    .course-body h3 {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .course-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .course-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; }
    .course-instructor {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    /* ── CREATIVE FEED ── */
    .creative-feed { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .feed-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 4rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .feed-features { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2rem; }
    .feed-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
    .feed-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }
    .feed-item h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
    .feed-item p { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--gray-500); line-height: 1.6; }
    .feed-visual {
      border-radius: 24px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5620C1 0%, #55DA9B 100%);
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 5rem;
      position: relative;
    }
    .feed-visual-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }
    .feed-mini-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    }
    .feed-mini-card-avatar {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
    .feed-mini-card-text {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: white;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .feed-mini-card-sub {
      font-size: 0.58rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
    }

    /* ── TEACHERS ── */
    .teachers-scroll-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      margin: 0 -2rem;
      padding: 0 2rem;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .teachers-scroll {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      padding-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .teachers-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .teacher-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 220px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: var(--white);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .teacher-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .teacher-avatar {
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: white;
    }
    .teacher-info { padding: 1rem; }
    .teacher-info h3 { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
    .teacher-info p { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--gray-500); font-weight: 600; }
    .teachers-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    .teachers-nav button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      background: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .teachers-nav button:hover { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--black); }

    /* ── TESTIMONIALS ── */
    .testimonials { background: var(--gray-50); }
    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    .testimonial-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 2rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      position: relative;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); }
    .testimonial-stars {
      color: #f59e0b;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
    }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .author-avatar {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: white;
    }
    .author-name { font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 800; }

    /* ── TEAMS ── */
    .teams {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5620C1 0%, #3a11a0 100%);
      color: white;
    }
    .teams-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 4rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .teams h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      line-height: 1.15;
    }
    .teams h2 span { color: var(--green); }
    .teams p { font-size: 1rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
    .btn-teams {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--green);
      color: var(--black);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-teams:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(85,218,155,0.35); }
    .teams-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
    }
    .teams-viz-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    .teams-viz-card:first-child { grid-column: span 2; }
    .teams-viz-card-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; }
    .teams-viz-card h4 { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 800; color: white; }
    .teams-viz-card p { font-size: 0.75rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); line-height: 1.5; }

    /* ── FAQ ── */
    .faq-list { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .faq-item {
      border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .faq-item:first-child { border-top: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200); }
    .faq-question {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 1.5rem 0;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .faq-question:hover { color: var(--purple); }
    .faq-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 300;
      transition: transform 0.3s, background 0.2s;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-icon { transform: rotate(45deg); background: var(--green); }
    .faq-answer {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.35s ease, padding 0.2s;
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-answer { max-height: 400px; }
    .faq-answer-inner {
      padding: 0 0 1.5rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    footer {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 4rem 2rem 2rem;
    }
    .footer-inner { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.5fr repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 2.5rem;
      padding-bottom: 3rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }
    .footer-brand { max-width: 260px; }
    .footer-brand .logo { font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .footer-brand p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); line-height: 1.6; }
    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .footer-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--green); }
    .footer-bottom {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .footer-bottom p { font-size: 0.8rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }
    .footer-fine { font-size: 0.72rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); max-width: 680px; margin-top: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6; }

    /* ── EMAIL MODAL ── */
    .modal-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      z-index: 1000;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
    }
    .modal-overlay.open { display: flex; }
    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 2.5rem;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 440px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .modal h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
    .modal p { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--gray-500); margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
    .modal-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 1.25rem;
      right: 1.25rem;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--gray-200); }
    .modal-input-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
    .modal-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
      outline: none;
    }
    .modal-input:focus { border-color: var(--purple); }
    .btn-modal-submit {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      border: none;
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 0.9rem;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: background 0.2s;
      margin-top: 0.25rem;
    }
    .btn-modal-submit:hover { background: var(--purple); }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .feed-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .teams-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .hero h1 { font-size: 2rem; }
      .hero-grid { display: none; }
      .stats-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1.25rem; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .nav-links { gap: 1rem; }
      section { padding: 3.5rem 1.25rem; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

    { title: "Portrait Photography Lighting Techniques", instructor: "Sean Dalton", students: "10,234", duration: "2h 30m", emoji: "💡", color: "#3b82f6", categories: ["photography"] },
    { title: "Macrame & Fiber Arts for Beginners", instructor: "Sophie Turner", students: "6,120", duration: "3h 10m", emoji: "🧶", color: "#f97316", categories: ["crafts"] },
    { title: "Productivity Systems for Creative Professionals", instructor: "Peggy Dean", students: "15,670", duration: "2h 05m", emoji: "⚡", color: "#10b981", categories: ["productivity"] },
  ];

  let activeCategory = 'featured';

  function renderCourses(category) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('coursesGrid');
    const filtered = allCourses.filter(c => c.categories.includes(category));
    const courses = filtered.length > 0 ? filtered : allCourses.slice(0, 8);

    grid.style.opacity = '0';
    grid.style.transform = 'translateY(8px)';
    grid.style.transition = 'opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s';

    setTimeout(() => {
      grid.innerHTML = courses.map(course => `
        <div class="course-card" onclick="alert('Opening: ${course.title.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
          <div class="course-thumb" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, ${course.color}22, ${course.color}44);">
            <span style="font-size: 3rem;">${course.emoji}</span>
            <span class="course-thumb-label">⏱ ${course.duration}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="course-body">
            <p class="course-instructor">${course.instructor}</p>
            <h3>${course.title}</h3>
            <div class="course-meta">
              <span>👤 ${course.students} students</span>
              <span style="color: var(--gray-300);">·</span>
              <span>🕐 ${course.duration}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      grid.style.opacity = '1';
      grid.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    }, 150);
  }

  function switchTab(btn, category) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    btn.classList.add('active');
    activeCategory = category;
    renderCourses(category);
  }

  /* ── TEACHERS ── */
  function scrollTeachers(dir) {
    const scroll = document.getElementById('teacherScroll');
    scroll.scrollBy({ left: dir * 260, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  /* ── FAQ ACCORDION ── */
  function toggleFaq(btn) {
    const item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
    const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('open'));
    if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
  }

  /* ── EMAIL MODAL ── */
  function openEmailModal() {
    document.getElementById('emailModal').classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }

  function closeEmailModal() {
    document.getElementById('emailModal').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  function closeModalOnOverlay(e) {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeEmailModal();
  }

  /* Escape key closes modal */
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeEmailModal();
  });

  /* ── INIT ── */
  renderCourses('featured');
</script>
</body>
</html>
